request.description: Adds a template for a key, channel and language that has none yet (skipped when `notificationTemplateId` is already set). Send `Idempotency-Key` to retry safely. Message templates per key, channel (`sms`, `email`, `push`) and language. Placeholders must be ones the sender provides (`availableParams`); sign-in and consent codes must keep `{{code}}`, staff invitations `{{token}}` and consent requests `{{link}}`. Email and push need a subject, SMS has none. A changed SMS text that already has a DLT template id needs its new id in the same change. The English template is the fallback and stays active. Compliance officers manage templates; ops leads and support read them.
